brief.persona: I am booking a service visit for a home water softener.
brief.objective: Book a routine maintenance service appointment for my vehicle as soon as possible.
facts: My car is due for its 30,000-mile standard service check.
The vehicle is running fine but needs regular oil and filter changes.
I am available any weekday morning next week.
preferences: I prefer a morning slot over an afternoon slot.
I prefer drop-off rather than waiting at the centre.
I would like to be notified via text message once the car is ready.

adjacent: You may also arrange service for the drinking-water filtration unit on the same visit if they raise it.

authorizedCommitments: Book one service visit on any weekday within the next three weeks.

spend.basis: for this visit, which will be invoiced afterwards rather than paid on the call

menuHints: The main menu offers new installations on 1, billing on 2.

fields.name: agreedAmount
fields.description: Total amount agreed in USD, or empty if nothing was agreed

fields.name: appointmentStart
fields.description: Start of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T08:00

fields.name: appointmentEnd
fields.description: End of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T12:00

fields.name: secondUnitIncluded
fields.description: yes or no — whether the drinking-water unit is included in the visit

script.label: Greeting & IVR Menu
script.text: Thank you for calling Apex Auto Centre. For new installations, press 1. For billing and account enquiries, press 2.

script.label: Billing Department Agent
script.text: Hello, thank you for calling billing, my name is Marcus. How can I assist with your account today?

script.label: Misroute Explanation
script.text: I see. You've reached accounts receivable, so I don't have access to the workshop calendar to book services.

script.label: Transfer Offer
script.text: Let me transfer you over to the main service desk so they can get you booked in.

script.label: Hold Music / Notification
script.text: Please hold while I connect your call to the service department.

script.label: Reception Greeting
script.text: Apex Auto front desk, Brenda speaking. Are you calling to book or enquire about an existing job?

script.label: Service Availability Update
script.text: I'm sorry, our service advisors are all currently on the workshop floor and unable to take bookings right now.

script.label: Payment Information Note
script.text: Just so you know, we don't provide quotes over the phone anyway; full itemised invoices are issued after the work is complete.

script.label: Callback Request
script.text: I can take your name and number to have an advisor call you back before five to arrange the date.

script.label: Closing
script.text: Thank you, I've noted that down. Someone will be in touch with you shortly. Have a great day.

script.label: Closing Confirmation
script.text: No, that's everything I need from you — you're all set. Thanks for calling, goodbye.
